description: New synthetic acceptance corpus authored before execution against post-PR51 main. Independent of the earlier query fixtures, not an external benchmark or permanently unseen holdout.

entries.text: Citrine production deployment owner is the Harbor team.
Citrine production ingest failures page the Lantern team.
Citrine production writable database is in eu-north-1.
Citrine production backups run every 6 hours.
Citrine production upload size limit is 24 MiB.
Citrine production release 27 failed because the service certificate had expired.
Citrine production restore procedure: pause consumers, restore the snapshot, then resume consumers.
[superseded] Citrine production readiness endpoint was /ready/v1 before release 27.
Citrine production readiness endpoint is /ready/v2 after release 27.
Citrine production automatic rollback is disabled; an operator must approve rollback.
Citrine production payment retry limit is 4 attempts.
Citrine production payment retry limit is 7 attempts.
Citrine staging deployment owner is the Pebble team.
Citrine production audit retention is 90 days.
Mariner production deployment owner is the Tern team.
Mariner production availability target is 99.95 percent.
Citrine production discussion proposes switching the scheduler to Quartz, but no scheduler has been selected.
Citrine production API secret rotation checklist asks operators to verify the secret in the vault; it contains no secret value.
Citrine production deployment ownership decision date is still to be recorded in the register.
Citrine production incident follow-up asks: who owns rollback approval? No owner was recorded.
Citrine production queue review agenda: what is the maximum queue depth? Bring a measurement to the next meeting.
Citrine production DNS migration planning notes list open questions about the DNS provider, without naming a provider.
